name: specio
description: Detect the technologies a website is built with.

scripts.bundle:background: bun build internal/background/index.ts --outfile dist/background/index.js --target browser --format esm --minify
scripts.bundle:content: bun build internal/content/index.ts --outfile dist/content/index.js --target browser --format iife --minify
scripts.bundle:content-main: bun build internal/content/main-world.ts --outfile dist/content/main-world.js --target browser --format iife --minify
scripts.bundle:popup: bun build internal/popup/index.ts --outfile dist/popup/index.js --target browser --format esm --minify
scripts.bundle: bun run bundle:background && bun run bundle:content && bun run bundle:content-main && bun run bundle:popup
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run bundle
scripts.package: bun run build && bun run scripts/package.ts
